$description: TEMPLATE brand pack. Copy this folder to brands/<your-body>/ and replace the values with your government body's identity, then build with BRAND=<your-body> npm run build. Keep every token PATH; change only values. Values must pass the AA contrast gate (test/brand-contrast.test.mjs) — keep primaryRamp.*.500 dark enough that white text on it stays ≥4.5:1. This example is an emerald + amber palette so a re-skin is visually obvious.

primaryRamp.$description: Example mode-aware primary ramp (emerald). 'light' = default, 'dark' = deep-green mode.
